jobs.title: Senior .net Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
PM-International
is one of Europe’s leading companies in the area of health, fitness and beauty sector.

We are currently number #5 in the DSN Global 100 ranking
, making us of the world’s leading companies in our industry. For more than 33 years, we have set up the highest standards to develop, manufacture and distribute our premium FitLine products – and we continue to grow every day!

PM-International
is combining creativity, innovation and state-of-the-art science with one vision in mind: to achieve market leadership in the distribution of high-quality products for health, fitness, and beauty worldwide. We support people all over the world to increase their life quality.

With our International Headquarters in Schengen, Luxembourg, we act as the strategic hub of our global operations, collaborating with our three regional headquarters and more than 45 subsidiaries worldwide. At the core of our success is our premium brand FitLine, with more than one billion products sold globally and trusted by customers worldwide, including more than 1,000 top athletes and associations from numerous disciplines.

We are hiring a  Senior .net Backend Engineer
within our IT Payments Team with a  Fixed-Term Contract for 6 months
to join our international team based in Schengen, Luxembourg immediately.

What Are Your Responsibilities

Build REST APIs in .NET 10 powering customer onboarding, payments, accounts, and risk systems
Integrate with different Payment Service Providers
Integrate SEPA messaging workflows and external payment providers
Integrate with Card Issuers ( BIN sponsors, issuer processors )
Build out monitoring, observability, logging, and alerting patterns
Provide architecture guidance on service decomposition, API contracts, data modelling and integration patterns

What Are The Requirements

10+ years backend engineering including driving architecture decisions
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science
Fintech / EMI / Payments background
.NET / C#, ideally including modern .NET versions experience
Nice to have: Azure knowledge (Bicep, Service Bus, Container Apps, Key Vault, APIM)
Nice to have: Familiarity with fraud and risk systems
Nice to have: Familiarity with KYC/AML processes in a financial institution

What Do We Offer

An international, young, and dynamic work environment at our global headquarters in Luxembourg
The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing, globally successful company and contribute to a premium brand with worldwide recognition
Great career path
A modern office culture built on in-person interaction and teamwork for those who enjoy being part of an active office environment
Being part of a multicultural and international team
Christmas Bonus
Lunch vouchers
Free parking
A generous voluntary social benefit program, including monthly free FitLine products and special purchase discounts
Free use of the in-house gym
Housing Allowance for employees residing in eligible Luxemburgish communes near Schengen
Company outings, afterwork parties, Christmas parties

€84,000 - €96,000 a year

At PM-International, you will have an opportunity to contribute, learn, grow, and make a difference. If this sounds like a perfect match for you, please include your CV in English
and a concise motivation letter, and communicate your salary expectations as well as the earliest date of entry possible. Incomplete applications cannot be considered.

You can review our Privacy Policy here and provide your consent later during the application process.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - ERP Developer (Microsoft BC)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission
and what we offer
.

Introduction

We're looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our team and take on a critical role in optimizing and extending our Microsoft Business Central (BC) environment. In this high-impact position, you will contribute to the configuration, customization, and integration of BC to support seamless business operations. You'll play a key role in building robust integrations with third-party applications, managing the underlying infrastructure, and leading our migration to the cloud-based version of BC. If you have hands-on experience with BC development, enjoy solving complex integration challenges, and are passionate about delivering scalable enterprise solutions, we want to hear from you.

This role is ideal for a strong full-stack engineer with expertise in ERP systems, particularly Microsoft Business Central, who thrives on tweaking configurations, deploying updates, and ensuring reliable data flows across our ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

What You'll Do

Configure, customize, and extend Microsoft Business Central using AL (Application Language) or C/AL, including building and maintaining custom pages, reports, and extensions to meet business needs.
Design, develop, and deploy integrations between Business Central and third-party applications via APIs (e.g., OData web services, REST APIs), enabling data synchronization for workflows like inventory, finance, and CRM.
Manage and optimize the Microsoft SQL Server database that powers Business Central, ensuring data integrity, performance tuning, high availability, and compliance with best practices.
Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools like Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for efficient deployment, testing, and versioning of BC customizations and extensions.
Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external vendors to gather requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deliver solutions that enhance operational efficiency.
Lead the planning and execution of our migration from on-premises Business Central to the cloud (SaaS) version, including data migration, configuration transfer, and minimal downtime strategies.
Uphold security, reliability, and monitoring standards for BC environments, including role-based access, audit trails, and proactive issue resolution.
Participate in on-call rotations as needed to support production systems and contribute to process improvements for faster incident response.

Qualifications

Requirements

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Business Central development, including configuration, extension building, and customization using AL/C/AL.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server management, including querying, indexing, backup/recovery, and performance optimization.
Expertise in CI/CD practices and tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, PowerShell scripting) for deploying and managing BC updates and extensions.
Proven track record in building API-based integrations (RESTful, SOAP, OData) with third-party systems, such as Salesforce, Shopify, or custom apps.
A strong product mindset with a focus on user experience, including designing intuitive extensions and workflows within BC.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to break down complex problems into actionable milestones that deliver quick value.
Curiosity and drive for continuous learning, especially around Microsoft ecosystem updates and cloud technologies.
Familiarity with ERP concepts and business processes (e.g., finance, supply chain) is essential.

Qualifications

We recognize that few candidates will have every skill listed, and we're committed to supporting your growth. If you meet most of these and are excited to dive deeper into Business Central, we'd love to talk!

Nice-to-Haves

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 integrations or other ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle).
Knowledge of cloud migration strategies for Business Central, including Azure-based deployments and hybrid setups.
Proficiency in Power Platform tools (e.g., Power Automate, Power BI) for enhancing BC workflows.
Background in agile methodologies and version control with Git.

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
